description: This file defines the EmployeeAddress class, which extends CombinedDisplayField, providing functionality for displaying employee address details in reports within the OrangeHRM system. It specifies the fields related to employee address and associated entity alias.

classes.name: EmployeeAddress
classes.description: Represents the employee address display field in reports, extending combined display capabilities for address-related data.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields representing the employee's address components.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity alias names used in database queries for this display field.
